relations.myth: Ratatoskr carries the eagle’s words down to Níðhǫggr
relations.note: Ratatoskr conveys the eagle’s hostile words to Níðhǫggr.

relations.myth: Ratatoskr carries reciprocal slander and provokes strife
relations.note: Ratatoskr carries malicious speech between Níðhǫggr and the eagle.
Góinn and Níðhǫggr are colocated beneath Yggdrasill without further interaction.
